pet_notes: Kusanagi Nene in her Brand New Style updated stage outfit, exactly as the official full-body reference. Long loose sage-grey hair, purple anime eyes, subtle shy deadpan smile, two small front hair bunches with pink ties. Asymmetric elegant stage dress: dark teal shoulder yoke edged in gold, pink striped neck bow, white pointed bodice with diagonal pink and pale yellow/teal edging and pastel colored buttons, pale yellow puff sleeves with white/lilac cuffs, long white flared gloves with teal/gold trim; dark teal flared layered skirt with gold hem, white ruffled underskirt, pale yellow and lavender ruffled side panels; short pointed white/teal coat tails and attached tiny yellow flower motifs. Teal and black ankle boots with white crossed straps and fluffy white cuff trim. On screen-right crown an attached tall mint/cream/yellow feather and white flower ornament with teal ribbon. Keep all ornaments attached, simplify fine trim at pet size, preserve asymmetry. No original yellow robot dress, no school uniform, no mermaid costume, no handheld props or floating effects. Personality: quiet, reserved, earnest and mildly sharp-tongued; restrained greeting, small stage hop, focused thinking, expectant asking and careful review.
style_notes: Japanese anime chibi illustration, 2.5-head-tall compact full-body character, clean thin dark outline, refined soft cel shading, muted pastel colors, recognizable violet anime eyes and sage-grey hair. Cute but reserved, same face and costume in every frame, no pixel art.
